player_prompt.intro:
Aweyi kɔnɔ {player_id} le **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Kɔnɔ kpaŋa kɛ **[macro  micro]** (kɔntɛmɛ ɖɛmɛ 0-8):
• *macro*  = ɛyaa mini-kɔnɔ kɛ a kɔnɔ
• *micro* = ɛyaa kɔntɛmɛ le mini-kɔnɔ ɛnɛ
Kɛlɛ kɛ `[7 8]` ➜ kɔnɔ a ɛyaa le mini-kɔnɔ 7, kɔntɛmɛ 8, pɛɛ
a kɔnɔ a ɖɔlɔ kɛ a kɔnɔ le mini-kɔnɔ 8 ɛnɛ.

Aweyi kɛ `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Pɩwɛɛ se pɛtɛzɩ-kɛ nɛ mayaɣ [macro micro] ŋga kɛwɛ 0-8 yɔ.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pɩwɛɛ se kɩ-tɛ yuŋ ɛwɛɛ kpaɣ 0 nɛ 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Mikro_plate, row yaa col fɛyɩ pɩ-taa.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Pɩwɛɛ se weyi ɛ-taa wɛ piti yɔ, ewolo nɛ ɛla tʋmɩyɛ lɛɛɖɛ.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Pɩtɛ lɛ, pɛtɛm wabʋ pɔɔyaɣ ŋga.

game_action.played: Aweyi {player_id} kɔnɔ le mini-kɔnɔ {macro_idx}, kɔntɛmɛ {micro_idx} (kɔntɛmɛ {row}, kɔntɛmɛ {col}). Aweyi {opponent_id} kɔnɔ kɛ kɔnɔ le {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Ŋʊnɛ {player_id} wɛnɛ Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
